def shapes(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen or g[a][b]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.add((a,b))
                    for d in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+d[0],b+d[1]
                        if 0<=na<len(g) and 0<=nb<len(g[0]): st.append((na,nb))
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
                pat=[[1 if (r0+i,c0+j) in cells else 0 for j in range(max(cs)-c0+1)] for i in range(max(rs)-r0+1)]
                out.append({'col':col,'cells':cells,'h':len(pat),'w':len(pat[0]),'pat':pat,'n':len(cells),'r0':r0})
    return out

def solve(g):
    sh=shapes(g)
    colors=sorted({s['col'] for s in sh}, reverse=True)
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    cpos=0
    for col in colors:
        grp=sorted([s for s in sh if s['col']==col], key=lambda s:(s['n'],s['r0']))
        # stack bottom-up
        rbottom=len(g)-1
        for s in reversed(grp):
            r0=rbottom-s['h']+1
            for i,row in enumerate(s['pat']):
                for j,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v: out[r0+i][cpos+j]=col
            rbottom=r0-2  # 1 blank row gap
        cpos+=max(s['w'] for s in grp)+1
    return out

def solve2(g):
    sh=shapes(g)
    # left column = color with smallest min column (leftmost reach)
    colors=sorted({s['col'] for s in sh}, key=lambda c: min(p[1] for s in sh if s['col']==c for p in s['cells']))
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(len(g))]
    cpos=0
    for col in colors:
        grp=sorted([s for s in sh if s['col']==col], key=lambda s:(s['n'],s['r0']))
        rbottom=len(g)-1
        for s in reversed(grp):
            r0=rbottom-s['h']+1
            for i,row in enumerate(s['pat']):
                for j,v in enumerate(row):
                    if v: out[r0+i][cpos+j]=col
            rbottom=r0-2
        cpos+=max(s['w'] for s in grp)+1
    return out
